streptavidin.note: PDB 1STP (2.6 Å X-ray, CC0): chain A residues 13–133 of 159 as deposited, made into the tetramer with the file's four BIOMT operators. Heavy atoms only (an X-ray structure has no hydrogen positions), van der Waals spheres in CPK colours. The abstract of Long et al. names a streptavidin-coated QD; how many streptavidins coat one dot is not stated.

biotin.note: The biotin end of the probe's biotinylated peptide binds here. Shown as deposited: free biotin in the binding pocket, not the peptide-linked form.
